Step 1 · Character lock

Same face in every shot

A reference image plus a fixed text block, pasted at the start of every prompt. This is how a microdrama keeps its leads recognisable across 50 clips.

Gabriel

23 · 5′7″ · slim · the romantic who feels too much.

Step 2 · Location lock

Five places, five fixed palettes

Each location gets one name, one colour mood and one light source. Reusing the exact wording keeps the world consistent.

L1 · Sunset balcony

Steel railing, city skyline, golden-hour backlight, birds.

L2 · Night bedroom

Warm bedside lamp, dark window, laptop glow on the face.

L3 · Rain window

Wet glass, blurred street lamps, cool blue-grey, tea cup.

L4 · 6th-floor flat, 3 AM

Valley window, highway lights twinkling, one dim lamp.

L5 · Flat door, 7 AM

Soft morning sun, birdsong, shoes by the exit.

Step 3 · Cut list

Episode 1 · “One Night, No Future”

The next three cuts from my story, each with shot size, camera move, light, sound and a ready-to-run prompt. Every prompt starts with the character and location locks.

Cut 1 · The Confession (hook)

⏱ 8s🎥 Close-up, 50mm↗ Slow push-in💡 One warm lamp🔊 Soft piano, silence
[LOCK] Gabriel (see lock) and Rachel (see lock). Location: small flat, night, one warm lamp. [SHOT] Close-up of Gabriel, eyes wet, whispering “I love you.” Rachel sits straight in front of him, expression turning serious. Slow push-in on his face, shallow depth of field, 9:16, cinematic, 8 seconds. [AUDIO] Soft piano, room tone, his whisper.

Cut 2 · The Lap (emotion)

⏱ 8s🎥 Over-shoulder, 35mm↗ Slow dolly-in💡 Blue night + city bokeh🔊 Distant highway hum
[LOCK] Gabriel + Rachel. Location L4: 6th-floor flat in a valley beside a highway, 3 AM. [SHOT] Rachel sleeps with her head in Gabriel’s lap. He strokes her hair and looks out of the window where city lights and passing vehicles twinkle like stars, then blur as his eyes fill. Slow dolly-in over his shoulder, moody blue tones, 9:16, 8 seconds. [AUDIO] Faint traffic hum, slow strings.

Cut 3 · The Goodbye (cliffhanger)

⏱ 8s🎥 Medium → hold on door↗ Static end hold💡 Soft 7 AM sun🔊 Birds, door click
[LOCK] Gabriel + Rachel. Location L5: flat door, 7 AM, morning light. [SHOT] Gabriel ties his shoes at the exit, looks back at sleeping Rachel, smiles with a heavy heart and mouths “bye”, then quietly closes the door. Hold on the closed door for one beat, cut to black. 9:16, 8 seconds. [AUDIO] Birdsong, a soft click, silence.
How I direct

My workflow

Lock characters

Reference image + one fixed description pasted into every prompt.

Lock locations

Named places with fixed light and colour mood.

Write the cut list

Shot size, move, light, sound and duration for each cut.

Generate best-of-N

Make several takes, pick the strongest, and reuse good frames as references.

The writing

Gabriel & Rachel · 21 Days as a Main Character

A young man who wants love meets a friend who wants to keep the friendship. One last night, no thoughts of the future. This is the story behind every clip above.
